title: 🦠 Data Fortress
description: A 3D tower defense game that teaches cybersecurity Data Fortress: players protect a core server from cyber threats by deploying defensive network modules. My bachelor's thesis.

title: 🏦 Student2Mass: Banking Shift
description: A research project with Tatra Banka on how students move from student to standard banking. Conducted 20 interviews, segmented customers and proposed retention strategies.

title: 🏕 Online Camp "What is it like to be a Game Maker?"
description: Coordinated an online camp where about 100 Belarusian participants learned the basics of game design in Unity and C#. Run by the Y Community with support from the EU and the Goethe-Institut Vilnius.

title: 🏆 2nd place at the hackathon
description: Our game "Red Riding Glitch" took 2nd place at Game Jam 2025 at TUKE, where I wrote C# gameplay scripts and animated models. We then improved it with mentoring from Games Farm and presented it at Lives IT Projects 2026.

title: 🤖 Google AI Certificate
description: A Google certificate on Coursera: writing effective prompts, how AI relates to machine learning, and using AI in everyday tasks.

images.alt: Google Prompting Essentials certificate issued to Artur Paulouski

title: 🇩🇰 DevOps course at DTU
description: Intensive course "One Pipeline to Deploy Them All" organized by BEST and hosted by the Technical University of Denmark. Built and presented a group DevOps project, working with professionals from Google, Novo Nordisk and Accenture.
